test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Because the politician’s speech was __high-flown and pretentious__, it gained popularity.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **bombastic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bombastic"** means high-sounding but with little meaning; inflated. (आडंबरपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **His bombastic speech was full of grandiose promises that he could never keep.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **bombastic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Austere **(कठोर): Having an extremely plain and simple style or appearance.

 
 
• **Example:** The room was decorated in a very austere style, with no frills or embellishments.
 
 
 
• **Schematising **(योजना बनाना): Arranging or organizing according to a scheme or a plan.
 
 
• **Example: **He spent hours schematising the new project to ensure everything was in place.
 
 
 
• **Mnemonic** (स्मृति सहायक): A device that assists in remembering something.
 
 
• **Example:** The mnemonic "HOMES" helps people remember the Great Lakes: Huron, Ontario, Michigan, Erie, and Superior.
